messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High latency detected for Redwood hosted inference API (us-east-1). 95th latency crossed 3s, request queue depth up 4x. Severity: P2. Pager: @Alex K. Link: https://ops.redwood/status/incident/1769912345
Alex K: I'm on it — looking at the autoscaler and routing. Starting a temporary route to dedupe and increase worker pool.
Alex K: Running scaling command now:
```bash
./infra scale --pool inference-us-east --add 4 --reason 'latency spike - emergency'
```
ops-bot: Autoscaler action: +4 workers started in inference-us-east (instances id: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0a1b2c3e). Expected warm-up ~ 45s.
Alex K: Warmed up two nodes, traffic rerouted to new pool. 95th latency dropping from 3.4s -> 1.1s after partial reroute. Error rate unchanged. Continuing to monitor.
Emma (CS): Heads up — customer signals: acme-co pipeline and buildlytics ingestion saw timeouts and some retries between 22:12-22:28 UTC. Estimated impacted requests: ~1.2% of total requests in that window. Acme has an open support ticket.
Priya R: Thanks @Emma (CS). We should prepare a brief status page update and an email for affected customers after we confirm root cause. Draft below — feedback?
Priya R: Status page draft:
```text
Summary: Intermittent latency spike in us-east-1 affected a subset of hosted inference requests from 22:12-22:30 UTC. Impact: elevated request latency and timeouts for ~1% of requests; error rates were unchanged. Mitigation: traffic rerouted and additional capacity added at 22:15 UTC; full recovery by 22:28 UTC. Next steps: post-incident review scheduled.
```
Priya R: Customer email template (short):
```text
Hi <Customer>,
We detected an intermittent latency spike affecting hosted inference in us-east-1 between 22:12-22:30 UTC on 2026-03-14. We rerouted traffic and added capacity; the service returned to normal at 22:28 UTC. We estimate <X> of your requests may have seen increased latency; our team is preparing an RCA and will share it by EOD tomorrow. If you need a joiner for a sync, let us know.
— Redwood Support
```
Jamie L: Proposed next: schedule a postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT. Owner: Alex K (technical RCA), Priya R (customer comms), Emma (CS) will coordinate direct customer follow-ups. Can everyone make it?
Liu: I can attend and help with metrics correlation + tracer logs.
Alex K: OK for 09:30 PT. Initial hypothesis: a quantization config changed during the last model rollout causing elevated memory pressure and longer K/V cache evictions — causing slower token generation for a subset of requests. I'll capture kernel-level logs and model config.
Jamie L: Action items tracked here — assign owners and due dates in thread: 
- Alex K: collect kernel & runtime logs, dump KV eviction traces, and prepare RCA notes (due: 2026-03-15 EOD).
- Priya R: publish status page update and customer email draft after postmortem (due: 2026-03-15 10:30 PT).
- Emma (CS): follow up with top 5 affected customers and include mitigation summary (due: 2026-03-15 09:00 PT).
- Liu: correlate telemetry and attach relevant dashboards to the postmortem doc (due: 2026-03-15 12:00 PT).
Alex K: Confirmed. I'll also prepare a temporary rollback plan if we find the rollout change is the culprit.
Priya R: If we want to pre-notify customers, Emma — can you send a quick note to the account teams now so they're not blindsided?
Emma (CS): Yup — pinging account owners now. I'll wait for the postmortem notes before sending formal customer RCA.
ops-bot: Incident update logged: mitigation step executed (reroute + scale). Incident state: mitigated. Next: postmortem scheduling.
Priya R: I'm going to post the preliminary status page entry (marked 'under investigation' -> update to 'resolved' after PM). Posting now.
Priya R: (posted) https://status.redwood/incident/1769912345 — let me know if wording needs to be softer.
Jamie L: Good. For the RCA doc, Alex — please include the exact model artifact digest, config diff, and any kernel oops or OOM logs. Also include sequence-length distribution during the spike.
Alex K: Will do. Early debug notes: memory pressure + increased LRU churn on KV cache. Suspect quantization-aware kernel path exercised differently due to longer sequences from a customer test job.
Priya R: Customer email finalization plan: after postmortem meeting we'll update email with root cause + fix ETA and send around 08:00 PT tomorrow to affected customers. @Emma (CS) to approve recipient list.
Emma (CS): Approved. I'll also offer a follow-up call for any customers who saw significant impact.
Jamie L: Ok team — postmortem meeting invite sent for 2026-03-15 09:30 PT (calendar link). Please attach any pre-reads to the event.
Alex K: Pre-read uploaded to the incident doc (logs + manifest).
Priya R: I'll prepare the customer-facing RCA draft during the mtg and drop it here for final review.
Liu: Adding dashboards and traces now.
Alex K: Hotfix plan: revert quantization config change that went out in the last rollout and re-run smoke tests. If revert passes, schedule controlled re-rollout with monitoring.
Jamie L: Great. We'll track the action items in the postmortem doc and mark owners. After customer email goes out and RCA is published, we'll close the incident thread. :white_check_mark:
Emma (CS): I'll send a quick internal note to customer success leads once Priya posts the final email. Good work everyone.
incident-bot: Incident 1769912345 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem scheduled.
Alex K: Closing loop here — I'll post the final RCA link in this thread after the meeting. Thanks all.
